summary: Vatican City, Monaco, San Marino, Liechtenstein and Malta come first; Nauru, Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands reward Pacific knowledge, and Andorra (#17) and Singapore (#20) are the traps.
reasons: Builder's own replay; free play only (owner). A casual found 8 and lost lives on Andorra, Luxembourg, Singapore and Bahrain, each with its area.
Sovereign states only, ranked smallest first: dependencies (Gibraltar, Macau, Bermuda, Hong Kong) have no rank in the table and are free.
A smaller number ranks higher, so it is never a Blitz.
